title: Evaluating the simultaneous retention of organic matter, organic contaminants, and Escherichia coli (E. coli) in biochar-amended biofilters
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW01025F, Paper
Johanna Jernberg, Tadele Haile, Bridget Ulrich
Commercial biochar type affected retention of organic matter and organic contaminants. While biochar amendment was not associated with improved E. coli retention, biochar-amended filters maintained faster drainage rates relative to sand-only filters.
